summary: Completed backend regression and live Web tab/bookmark/beforeunload validation on preview URL. Core tab management, bookmark flows, persistence, responsive layout, and native leave-warning behaviors are working. Live content origin still serves legacy protocol1 assets, so protocol2 lifecycle coverage remains deployment-blocked.

minor.issue: Live content host still serves legacy shell (`send('ready')` without protocol2 requestId lifecycle safeguards). Repo has protocol2 code, but deployed asset is older.

ui_bugs.issue: Unsafe/duplicate tab payload restores as one blank-address tab but keeps malformed custom title (e.g., 'bad') instead of resetting to canonical blank tab title.

action_items: Deploy updated protocol2 assets to the live content host (at minimum /workspace/frame.mjs and /browse/sw.js) and retest lifecycle/requestId paths on preview.
Normalize malformed restored blank tabs to canonical title ('New tab') when URL sanitization clears unsafe values.
Optional: add deterministic iframe-level test hook for internal-link click validation in isolated proxy flow.
critical_code_review_comments: readWorkspace() currently filters duplicate tab ids before URL sanitization, allowing first malformed duplicate to define restored tab title despite unsafe URL being stripped.
Live content host artifact drift is the main blocker for protocol2 production verification; app repo code and live shell are out of sync.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://calc-unblocked.preview.emergentagent.com/web using live endpoints. Backend regression: 11/11 passed. Confirmed: tab create/switch/close behaviors (including active-adjacent close, background close unchanged, close-last creates blank), cap20 + recover, dropdown selection, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End, independent per-tab address/history (typed navigation), bookmarks add/edit/remove/search/duplicate reject/invalid URL reject/cancel behavior, storage error banner on setItem failure, reload persistence, beforeunload dismiss + accept close with separate page, reload/external warning shown and dismiss keeps page, internal SPA route no warning, responsive 320/768/1024/1440 no horizontal overflow, data-testid duplicate scan clean. Notes route still loads after web workspace tests. Known/expected: heavy third-party console/runtime warnings from proxy stack and site compatibility; TikTok compatibility remains unresolved external behavior.
rca of the issue: Primary unresolved blocker is deployment drift: local repo contains protocol2 (`requestId`, `send('ready', {protocol:2})`, navigation-failure payloads with URL filtering) but content.desmos.lol serves legacy protocol1 shell (`send('ready')` only). Additional minor restore inconsistency comes from duplicate-id filtering order in `readWorkspace`: malformed first duplicate tab survives title while URL is sanitized empty, producing a blank-address tab with stale malformed title.
